name: Yuukidou Satoru
source: [spoiler]A young man with little memory of who he is or why he's at SPHIA in the first place. He remembers nothing that happened to him personally, but remembers his ex, Mayuzumi Rin. The first memory episode he has is of him falling off the clock tower at SPHIA.[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]A young man with little memory of who he is or why he's at SPHIA in the first place. He remembers nothing that happened to him personally, but remembers his ex, Mayuzumi Rin. The first memory episode he has is of him falling off the clock tower at SPHIA.[/spoiler]
